When is your team's match kicking off? (Getty Images: Aaron M. Sprecher)

The FIFA World Cup 2026 gets underway on June 12 at the iconic Estadio Azteca in Mexico City.

With a whopping 104 matches taking place across a variety of time zones, it's pretty easy to get confused about when each match involving your team is taking place.

Fortunately, we've got you covered in our day-by-day kick-off guide to the tournament.

To help all you Socceroos fans out, the Australian team's matches are highlighted in bold.

Check out all the times of every game below and don't forget, ABC Sport will have live coverage of every match, starting with the opener on Friday morning featuring co-hosts Mexico and South Africa.
